title: Long-Run Property Market Trends in New Zealand and Australia
summary: Where are NZ house prices heading over the next five years? An evidence-based look at long-run data, credit conditions, and what happened in similar countries.

title: Tax Optimisation for New Zealand SMEs and Their Owners
summary: A practical, officially sourced guide to legitimate tax savings for NZ small and medium businesses and their owners — covering entity choice, deductions, provisional tax, and the incentives Parliament has deliberately provided.

title: NZ First-Home Buyers and the Property Market: Testing the Common Assumptions
summary: Who is buying homes in New Zealand, and what really drives prices? This brief tests common beliefs against official data. Covers first-home buyers, overseas buyers, regional price gaps, interest rates, migration, and building supply.

title: Why I Bought a Lotto Ticket This Week (Despite Knowing the Maths)
summary: Wednesday's Powerball is $35 million and the odds are 1 in 38.4 million. I bought a ticket anyway. Here is the logic — and it is not as irrational as it sounds.

title: AI and Digital Transformation: Impact on Business Practices, Firm Performance, and Corporate Reporting
summary: An evidence-based review of AI and digital transformation from 2015-2025, covering adoption trends, productivity effects, audit transformation, disclosure implications, and research opportunities for accounting scholars.

title: AI Tokens as an Emerging Asset Class: Economic Logic, Market Evidence, and Accounting Implications
summary: An analysis of AI-specific crypto tokens as an emerging asset class, from market evolution and corporate adoption to accounting treatment under FASB ASU 2023-08 and IFRS.

title: Blockchain and Cryptocurrency in Business: Development, Corporate Adoption, and Impact (2009-2026)
summary: A systematic review of blockchain and cryptocurrency in business from 2009-2026, covering market cycles, corporate treasury adoption, ETF inflows, accounting standards, regulation, and systemic risk.

title: Cybersecurity Risk Disclosure by Publicly Listed Firms: State, Drivers, and Consequences
summary: A research brief on the post-mandate cybersecurity disclosure landscape, covering SEC rules, NIS2 and DORA, filing patterns, market consequences, and research opportunities.

title: Textual Analysis and NLP in Accounting and Finance Research: A Twenty-Year Review (2005-2025)
summary: A twenty-year review of textual analysis and natural language processing in accounting and finance, covering data sources, six methodological phases, applications, validation concerns, and publication trends.

title: Big Data and AI in Business Operations: Google Trends Nowcasting of New Zealand Tourism Demand and AI Adoption in the Sector
summary: A data-driven brief testing whether Google Trends can nowcast New Zealand visitor arrivals, alongside a review of AI adoption across the country's tourism and hospitality sector.

title: Understanding Large Language Models and Their Implications for Accounting and Finance Research
summary: A plain-language primer for accounting and finance scholars on how large language models work, what they can and cannot do, and where the research opportunities lie.
